# Parse each file path to extract date, file_name, and extension
base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_data/'
parsed = []
for f in files:
    # Extract filename from full path
    filename = f.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and the rest

    # Split rest on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name, ext = rest, ''
    parsed.append((f, date_part, file_name, ext))
